summary: Iteration 6: Tested personalized message feature for bouquet orders and subscriptions. All 11 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. The personalized_message field is correctly accepted by both /api/subscriptions/checkout and /api/orders/checkout endpoints and included in Stripe metadata.

pre_existing_issues.issue: Product page route /shop/:slug is not defined in App.js - clicking on product cards shows 'No routes matched location' error in console
pre_existing_issues.note: This is a pre-existing issue, not related to the personalized message feature. Quick View modal works as a workaround for adding items to cart.

Backend: GET /api/products returns products
